purpose: Guardrails for Blender 5.x compatible generated scripts.

blocked_patterns.reason: Musgrave shader node is not available in the target Blender 5.x environment seen in project failures.
blocked_patterns.replacement: Use ShaderNodeTexNoise, ShaderNodeTexVoronoi, ColorRamp, or procedural noise combinations.

warning_patterns.reason: Verify Blender enum compatibility on the local target version before accepting generated code.
Hardcoded workstation paths must be marked local-only or moved to config.
Scene deletion should be explicit, configurable, and documented.

preferred_patterns: short render test before candidate status
